description: This file defines a PHP trait `ClaimRequestAPIHelperTrait` that provides helper methods related to claim requests in an HRM system. It includes methods for permission checks (`isActionAllowed`) and fetching claim request records (`getClaimRequest`), utilizing other traits and service classes relevant to claims and user roles.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted on a given claim request based on the user's role and workflow state.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a claim request by ID, ensures it exists, and checks user access rights.
